title: 天色变成深紫色
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: ONE original full-bleed vertical 9:16 watercolor story illustration for one locked narration shot. Use every input according to its explicitly labelled role; preserve the existing named identities, not just their species. Input 1: identity for 皮皮 (pipi), preserve exactly: 暖灰毛、圆脸、粉色小鼻、自然下垂长耳；身份不随活动和换装变化。 Input 2: clothing only for 皮皮: 换装表左：灰蓝短背带裤、米色上衣、蓝布鞋、小黄书包，无帽；仅画这套服装，不复制表中其他兔子。 Input 3: identity for 团团 (tuantuan), preserve exactly: 暖棕圆脸、蓬松弯尾、奶油色胸前、小耳朵。 Input 4: environment layout / watercolor style ONLY. Keep the geography and furnishings, but draw ONLY the requested people and props for this shot, never copy unwanted actors. This is not an image to reuse as the output.
Visible characters: 皮皮 (pipi), 团团 (tuantuan). Exact total number of visible characters: 2. Do not draw extra background animals. Standing body-height ratios (not ear or tail tips): 皮皮 1.0, 团团 0.9. Pipi wears ONLY the LEFT daytime outfit from the wardrobe sheet: dusty blue overalls, oatmeal shirt, blue cloth shoes, small yellow backpack. No star cap in daytime. Tuantuan wears the short dark ochre/rust scarf. Scene continuity: 树屋旁的云彩刚变成深紫色，皮皮背起小黄书包准备回家，团团留在树屋边道别。
The SINGLE visual moment and framing: 皮皮转向熟悉的小路，神情满足、自然；团团只在此镜出现。
Emotional performance for this exact beat: Pipi is happily ready to go home, relaxed and satisfied; Tuantuan gives a friendly wave.
Mandatory pose/prop state (overrides neutral model-sheet poses): 单一竖屏水彩画，无画中文字、水印、拼贴边框或额外角色。画面下方保留低细节字幕区；叶子、鞋、花盆、床、拖鞋和胡萝卜玩偶的数量/位置按continuity.json。
Style: hand-painted gentle watercolor on fine warm paper, muted natural hues, soft edges and rounded shapes, quiet storybook mood, no glossy 3D or photorealism. Daylight scenes use soft greens and warm daylight, not bedroom amber tint. Night scenes use soft warm lamplight and muted gray-blue windows. Composition: full-bleed vertical 9:16. Keep all important faces, hands, feet, biscuits, fabric folds and other story actions in the upper 68% of the image. Bottom 32% is low-detail negative space for later subtitles, with no crucial objects there. Make the specified story state visually understandable. Text: NONE. No words, labels, subtitles, numbers, logos, watermark, speech bubbles, panels, frames or collage. Do not reproduce model sheets, multiple versions of a character, or wardrobe lineups. Each named character appears exactly once. This is a new single coherent scene, not a copy of the references. No motion streaks or implied camera zoom. Never turn a metaphor into a real transformation: yellow blankets remain fabric, imagined grassy softness is not actual grass growing in bed. No new story events.
